name: LEGOLAS R5.1-R6 development preregistration
authorization: owner approval 2026-11-27: gvlab2 + local; <=40 CPU-h, <=10 summed GPU process-h (incl. R5.0 0.52), <=4 GiB, 12 h wall. Local machine has 1.4 GB free on /home (< 20 GiB floor) and no visible GPU: used only for git / figures / reports.
status: DEVELOPMENT. Nothing here is confirmation; no TEST / release_v2; production artefacts immutable; final clean training is R7.

new_2d.recipe: R4.3 witness-first cages + prefix templates (verified relocations of the family's own cage walls; no added bodies) -> h1 g3, h2 g2, h2 g3 matched permutations; nuisance stage kept for density tracking
new_2d.teacher: unchanged BXY primitives, fresh cache per query

new_3d.namespace: R5.1 (deep3d NS), first 60 fresh families in sha256('R5.1|fam') order excluding KGT3 and R4.4
new_3d.recipe: R4.4 level-2/3 construction, Z search widened to 8 objects x 2 destinations (two irrelevant prefixes -> h2 / h3)

R5_1_data.split_rule: new families: VAL iff int(sha256('R5.1-split|' + parent_family)[:8], 16) / 2^32 < 0.40, else TRAIN; fixed before outcomes
train_sources: original v32 TRAIN replay (historical contract, unchanged) = ORIGINAL supervision
ADDITIONAL (strict: replayed positives + certified negatives only, chunks <= 3): R3.1 TRAIN_SCALE + VAL_SCALE, KGT3 P2 (all splits except 2D GATE), R4.3 (all 60), R4.4 (all 34), R5.1 TRAIN
val_sources: 2D only: KGT3 P2 2D GATE families (never read by any model; disclosed)
permanently_excluded_from_training: R6 sparse 2D demonstration families (separate namespace R6-2D-DEMO)
R5_1_data.if_minima_fail: collect additional targeted families in a new namespace (same recipe), bounded by the envelope; else DATA_LIMITED
R5_1_data.historical_audit: original supervision and R3.1 labels are reported under their historical contracts; strict filtering applies to ADDITIONAL data only and drop counts are reported

fixed: observed-data likelihood (xy.batched_log_evidence), marginalising unknown X / Y
family-balanced local sampling, replay batches as R3

X_representation: A: original ordered XYNet X modules (act, pairo, mix, order_s, xy) re-initialised

R5_2_training.recipe_check: seed 0, data 1, each representation: R_lo = lr 1e-4, <=60 epochs, patience 10; R_hi = lr 1e-3, <=60 epochs, patience 10 (R3 scratch recipe). Per representation choose the recipe with the lower VAL family NLL; applied to all cells of that representation. Convergence (best epoch < max) recorded; if best epoch == max for the chosen recipe, rerun once with <=120 epochs.
R5_2_training.selection: primary metric = VAL family-mean marginal-X NLL on strict local VAL labels. Representation order of simplicity A < M < G. Choose the simplest representation whose seed-mean VAL NLL is within max(seed spread of the best, 0.005) of the best seed-mean.

controls_on_selected_representation.order_invariant: chunk actions canonically sorted at input (orders indistinguishable)
controls_on_selected_representation.direct_short: same net trained with BCE on observed short-sequence success (p11 target) from replay success labels only; compared on K<=3 / short metrics only

reported: VAL NLL, Brier, ECE (10 bins), AUROC, AUPRC by h and g
K<=3 X regression on original VAL replay roots (NLL / AUROC) and Y bitwise identity
training curves, best epoch, seed spread, wall, params
R5_2_training.physical_order_diagnostic: R4.2 protocol (20 exposed 3D roots, assignment given, one sealed order + partition) for the selected model and the best model of each other representation; diagnostic only, never selection

R5_3_scoring.models: selected X per domain (and F0 as control)
R5_3_scoring.length_audit: energy by size / partition / chunks, has_multi constrained vs all-singleton-inclusive, terminal Y by number of edits, on DEV roots model-only
R5_3_scoring.calibration: temperature T on the X conditional logits (a, a + w) fitted on R5.1 VAL local labels only; marginal pX / p11 recomputed; raw vs calibrated reported

selection_rules.S2: reliability-threshold shortest: among candidates whose calibrated sum-of-chunk -log pX <= tau (tau = 5th percentile of the same statistic on VAL positive multi-chunk local labels, i.e. derived from local VAL only), choose the shortest, ties by E; if none, S1

admission_rules.A1: temporary pY after group >= temporary no-op pY + m, m chosen on R5.1 VAL temporary-target labels (R4.4 TEMP-style interventions in R5.1 3D) as the smallest m with false-admission <= 0.2

proposals.P2: REC local resampling: bounded ancestral <= 64 draws per object on the current hypothetical temporary scene

R5_3_scoring.choice: one scoring rule, one admission rule and one proposal setting per domain chosen on DEV model-only diagnostics + local VAL evidence (never on R6 physical outcomes); frozen before R6 plans
R5_3_scoring.cVAE_recovery_2D: only if frozen P0-P2 recover < 50% of 2D reference actions within a 64-draw budget: existing TaskCVAE architecture, original staged recipe (placement pretraining then task-conditioned fine-tuning) from fresh initialisation, original + R5.1/R4.3 TRAIN local verified placements (chunk <= 3, verified in their own starting state); family-disjoint VAL; Y frozen; production cVAE untouched; separate checkpoint path

R6.budget: planners.CFG unchanged (180 s wall incl. floor + 5 s selection reserve; x_unique 1.5M; y_unique 600k)
arms: H3 (same selected X, rank.b0 K<=3 rule)

roots.2d_dense: coh2d DEV roots with L_ref 4/5 (K6 excluded by evaluator-only filtering); 10-job pilot, stop if > 50% UNRESOLVED
roots.2d_sparse_demo: separately constructed held-out families (namespace R6-2D-DEMO), clearly labelled, never pooled with the dense panel

R6.protocol: plans sealed before any teacher query; one plan per root and arm; no retries / replacement; NOOP / ABSTAIN / TIMEOUT counted as not verified
R6.gate: per domain x method: DEV_IMPLEMENTED / DEV_PHYSICALLY_DEMONSTRATED (replay-verified > 3-action success from a non-oracle primary planner) / BLOCKED
